title: Savory Kachori Buns
description: A Chinese twist on the Indian street food, these crispy buns are filled with a flavorful and savory mixture of herbs and spices.

ingredients.name: Indian spices
ingredients.notes: curry powder, cumin powder, coriander powder

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the sesame oil and quietly to the pan and stir until combined.
Add the crumbled kachori and cook for 2-3 minutes or until lightly browned.
Add the curry powder, cumin powder, and coriander powder to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Split the buns in half and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the buns by spooning the kachori mixture onto the bottom half and topping with the top half.
Garnish with chopped scallions and sesame seeds.
